page.meta_description: Tokyo, once Edo, is still the capital of nigiri prestige: markets, apprenticeships, and the shops that trained the global omakase boom. Related pages:…
page.content:
City of Edomae sushi, Ginza counters, and the central fish markets.

How Tokyo connects

  • Location: Sukiyabashi Jiro — Sukiyabashi Jiro is a Ginza counter in Tokyo.
  • Location: Tsukiji Market — Tsukiji Market sat in central Tokyo as the inner wholesale market.
  • Location: Toyosu Market — Toyosu Market is Tokyo's current central wholesale fish market.
  • Location: Edo — Edo is the former name and urban setting of what became Tokyo.

What is Tokyo?

Tokyo, once Edo, is still the capital of nigiri prestige: markets, apprenticeships, and the shops that trained the global omakase boom.

Key threads lead to Sukiyabashi Jiro, Tsukiji Market, Toyosu Market and Edo.
